page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword/signature line at foot ("I 5" signature and "nihi" catchword at lower right of text block).

main_text.p: tinere vacationem septimi dieiab omni opere servili; sed septimum explicuit, illà numeratione quæ à Judeis observabatur: interim ad nos omninò pertinere, quod in illo Præcepto erat morale, fidemque & charitatem spectabat; utpotè beneficia Dei memorare & gratias pro eisagere, & remittere opera familiæ (N.B.) quâlibet septimanâ die uno. Confer, si placet, locum ejusdem Buceri ab Hoornbekio nuper allegatum, initio tractatûs sui de Die Solis, die Quietis (Son-dag/ Rust-dag).

3. Charitas amat Deum suprà omnia alia, & antè ea; amat etiàm normam justitiæ & sanctitatis morumque vivendi ab ipso præscriptam: quæ Decalogo summatim comprehensa. Fides Euangelica veritates Divinas de Christo, & salute per eum æternâ, spectat; atque itâ sanctificationem seu purificationem peccatorum nostrorum: imò secundùm œconomiæ diversitatem, nunc hujus impetrandæ conditiones à Christo præstitas esse; sub V. T. eas fuisse prędictas, præfiguratas, expectandas. Verùm indè non sequitur, vel Præcepta Decalogi omnia, vel unum eorum, nihil

page.notes: Marginal note mark "(N.B.)" is in the text. Ink blot over "tractatûs" and "Son-dag" line partly damaged. Word "nihi'" at foot is a catchword, possibly incomplete; the final line is partly cut at the edge. Some letters uncertain, e.g. "Præcepta" line, "ejusdem", "eas fuisse" (printed "fuisse" with damage).
